note: _fornicarii_ are excluded from the kingdom of God. Translations simply transcribe the word as “fornicators” (Douay Version) or “fornicateurs” (Glaire) or use vague terms such as “the debauched” (Knox), “Unzüchtige” (Allioli) or “Hurer” (Tusculum-Vulgata). Early-modern commentators thought that the word refers to pederasts; Adam L. Wirrig: _Trial of Translation. An Examination of 1 Corinthians 6:9 in the Vernacular Bibles of the Early Modern Period_. Eugene, Ore. 2022. 174 pp. See above, the glossary s.v. _fornicarius_ (Chapter 19.2).
